final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested names and added MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`. All 40 PCs point to the lab’s recursive resolver; existing addresses, routes, connections, and images were preserved.

The artificial root runs on pc1, the resolver on pc2, and the authoritative `.com`, `.net`, `.edu`, and `.it` zones on pc3–pc6 respectively. The configuration assumes an isolated, IPv4-only DNS hierarchy.

Shell syntax checks passed. Runtime DNS resolution remains unverified, and the local BIND validation tools were unavailable. The MX records identify the mail hosts; they do not configure mail services.
